blocks.raw: <Tip>**Detention = temporary storage (lowers peak flow); Retention = permanent storage/infiltration (eliminates runoff).** Permeable surfaces are cheaper and better than gray infrastructure. SuDS provides water quality AND quantity benefits.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing detention (temporary) with retention (permanent); both reduce peak flows, but retention eliminates downstream runoff","Assuming detention basins pollute water; properly designed detention settles sediment and improves quality via settling time","Treating stormwater management as separate from site design; modern design integrates runoff reduction (permeable surfaces, retention, green roofs) throughout","Applying only gray infrastructure (pipes, concrete basins) when green infrastructure (rain gardens, permeable pavement, swleas) is more cost-effective and multifunctional","Forgetting that RA 9275 requires stormwater treatment (not just detention) from commercial and high-density residential developments"]} />
